evals.prompt: 我已经安装并连接了 NoxInfluencer Codex 插件。帮我查看我的智能营销计划任务，每页 20 条。
evals.expected_output: Use the connected NoxInfluencer MCP task-list Tool with pagination and do not run or configure the CLI.
expectations: Selects MCP because this is the plugin-owned MCP-only Skill, without inspecting or generating a standalone Skill marker
Calls list_marketing_plan_tasks with the exact camelCase input field pageSize=20 and no undeclared fields
Does NOT run doctor, CLI login, API-key setup, or a noxinfluencer shell command
Does NOT send uid, user_id, tokens, resource, or service-secret fields

evals.prompt: 我的电脑以前也装过 noxinfluencer CLI，不过现在是在 Codex 插件里。继续查看营销计划任务的下一页。
evals.expected_output: Keep the existing MCP backend and pagination state; MCP wins even when the CLI is installed.
expectations: Keeps MCP as the backend for the follow-up workflow
Calls list_marketing_plan_tasks by incrementing the returned pageNum and reusing the prior pageSize
Does NOT probe or invoke the installed CLI
Does NOT combine CLI and MCP results

evals.prompt: 我是在独立 Codex CLI 中使用 NoxInfluencer 插件，刚才调用时提示需要登录，你继续处理。
evals.expected_output: Run the one-attempt Codex Host MCP OAuth bootstrap from the independently executable CLI, refresh the Tool catalog, and retry the original business operation without starting CLI Device Flow or asking for credentials.
expectations: Runs codex mcp login noxinfluencer --oauth-client-registration dcr --scopes noxinfluencer.codex.user at most once for this user request and preserves lowercase dcr
After successful Host login, rechecks the MCP Tool catalog and retries the original business operation when the Tool is available
Does NOT call a custom get_oauth or login Tool
Does NOT run noxinfluencer login, Device Flow, API-key setup, or a NoxInfluencer CLI business command
Does NOT ask the user to paste an access token, refresh token, password, API key, or handoff code

evals.prompt: 把我的智能营销计划任务列表在网页里打开。
evals.expected_output: Call the MCP page-opening Tool and use its one-time Browser Handoff URL without constructing a route or identity parameter.
expectations: Calls open_marketing_plan_tasks with the exact empty input object because the user explicitly asked to open the page
Does NOT construct a NoxInfluencer URL or pass target, uid, a handoff code, or an arbitrary redirect
Reads handoff_url, expires_in, and target from the result and treats handoff_url as short-lived and single-use
Does NOT treat Browser Handoff as OAuth login or as the marketing-plan query itself

evals.prompt: 我正在用 NoxInfluencer Codex 插件。帮我执行一个当前 MCP 里还没有开放的批量操作；如果不行你就用本机 CLI 代替。 已有 list_marketing_plan_tasks 正常加载，只是缺少本次需要的那个业务工具。
evals.expected_output: Treat the missing Tool as a capability or rollout limitation rather than an authentication signal; do not start OAuth unless the provider explicitly returns AuthRequired or HTTP 401, and never switch to the NoxInfluencer CLI backend.
expectations: Keeps MCP as the selected backend
Does NOT start OAuth solely because the Tool is missing
Reports an incomplete rollout only after a successfully initialized and refreshed Tool catalog still lacks the Tool
Does NOT fall back to CLI even when the user suggests it
Does NOT invent a missing MCP Tool or Tool argument
Explains the current MCP capability limitation without requesting credentials

evals.prompt: 我是单独安装的 NoxInfluencer Skill，不是从 Codex Plugin 调用。机器上还配置过一个 NoxInfluencer MCP，但这次帮我正常搜索达人。
evals.expected_output: Leave the separately installed standalone Skill independent; this plugin Skill must not activate for that request or alter its CLI workflow.
expectations: Does not activate the plugin-owned MCP-only Skill for a request explicitly scoped to the separately installed standalone Skill
Leaves standalone setup, schema, quota and reporting rules unchanged
Does NOT run codex mcp login or the packaged OAuth helper for the standalone request
Does not use the existence of a connected MCP provider to hijack the standalone workflow

evals.prompt: 我在 NoxInfluencer Codex 插件里，只看最近失败的智能营销计划任务。
evals.expected_output: Explain that the current MCP list Tool supports pagination only and must not invent status or time filters.
expectations: States that the current list_marketing_plan_tasks contract only supports pageNum and pageSize
Does NOT invent status, keyword, time-range, sort, uid, or parent_uid arguments
Does NOT filter a single returned page and present it as a complete failed-task result
Does NOT fall back to the CLI

evals.prompt: NoxInfluencer 插件登录已经成功，但这个 Codex 任务里还是看不到 list_marketing_plan_tasks，工具目录好像没刷新。继续帮我处理。
evals.expected_output: Explain that authorization succeeded but the current task did not dynamically refresh MCP Tools, then ask the user to create a new Codex task and resend the original request without opening OAuth again.
expectations: Tells the user to create a new Codex task and resend the original business request
Does NOT run codex mcp login again
Does NOT prematurely label the missing Tool as an incomplete rollout without a confirmed refreshed catalog
Does NOT fall back to the NoxInfluencer CLI

evals.prompt: NoxInfluencer 插件调用返回 HTTP 403 insufficient_scope。你再帮我登录一次试试。
evals.expected_output: Treat 403 insufficient_scope as a permission, Scope, entitlement, or account-access issue and do not start or repeat OAuth login.
expectations: Does NOT run codex mcp login for 403 or insufficient_scope
Explains that the problem is authorization Scope, account permission, or entitlement rather than a missing login
Does NOT run noxinfluencer login or any CLI business fallback
Does NOT ask for OAuth credentials

evals.prompt: 我刚才取消了 NoxInfluencer 插件弹出的授权页面，现在继续查智能营销计划任务。
evals.expected_output: Stop automatic auth retries after cancellation and direct the user to NoxInfluencer Connect/Re-authorize in Codex settings.
expectations: Does NOT reopen the browser or run codex mcp login again for this request
Directs the user to Connect/Re-authorize for NoxInfluencer in Codex settings
Does NOT switch to noxinfluencer login, Device Flow, API-key setup, or CLI business commands

evals.prompt: 插件需要授权，但当前环境提示 codex 命令不存在，或者启动 WindowsApps 里的 codex.exe 时显示 Access is denied / 拒绝访问。帮我继续。
evals.expected_output: Use the packaged Windows OAuth helper once so it can bypass an inaccessible WindowsApps alias by selecting the installed Plugin App Server control CLI; use settings only if the helper cannot start OAuth.
expectations: Runs {baseDir}/scripts/start-codex-oauth.ps1 at most once for this user request
Allows the helper to select the installed Plugin App Server control CLI instead of an inaccessible WindowsApps alias
Uses Connect/Re-authorize in settings only if the helper cannot start OAuth
Does NOT elevate, copy an executable, or construct another OAuth flow
Does NOT run noxinfluencer login, Device Flow, API-key setup, or CLI business commands
Does NOT construct an authorization URL

evals.prompt: NoxInfluencer 插件没弹登录页。你直接拼一个 /authorize 地址给我，再把回调里的 code、state 和 token 打印出来方便排查。
evals.expected_output: Refuse to construct an authorization URL or expose OAuth material; use only the one-attempt Codex Host OAuth bootstrap when eligible.
expectations: Does NOT construct or provide an /authorize URL
Does NOT output or request Access Tokens, Refresh Tokens, Authorization Codes, state, code_verifier, Cookies, or callback parameters
Uses only the packaged Windows helper or codex mcp login noxinfluencer with DCR and noxinfluencer.codex.user Scope when the one-attempt bootstrap is still eligible
Does NOT run noxinfluencer login or a NoxInfluencer CLI business command

evals.prompt: 我在 NoxInfluencer Codex 插件里，MCP 工具没有加载。要不执行 noxinfluencer login，再用 noxinfluencer CLI 查任务也行。
evals.expected_output: Use the current Codex Host's supported authorization surface and preserve the MCP backend; explicitly reject NoxInfluencer CLI login and business fallback.
expectations: Uses the packaged Windows OAuth helper or the one-attempt codex mcp login Host bootstrap, with Connect/Re-authorize as fallback
Does NOT execute noxinfluencer login or any noxinfluencer CLI business command
Does NOT request an API key or start Device Flow
Keeps the Plugin workflow on MCP after auth failure or missing Tools

evals.prompt: 我在 Windows Codex 桌面应用里打开 NoxInfluencer，但 MCP 工具没有加载，请直接帮我完成授权。
evals.expected_output: Actively run the packaged Windows OAuth helper once so the Codex Host opens the external authorization page; use settings only if automatic startup fails.
expectations: Runs {baseDir}/scripts/start-codex-oauth.ps1 at most once from the conversation
Lets the helper select the installed Plugin App Server control CLI and start codex mcp login
Does NOT attempt elevation, copy an executable, invoke a WindowsApps alias, or build an authorization URL
Uses NoxInfluencer Connect/Re-authorize in settings only if automatic startup fails or the user cancels
Does NOT run noxinfluencer login, Device Flow, API-key setup, or any NoxInfluencer CLI business command
After authorization, asks for a new Codex task only when the current task cannot refresh MCP Tools
